title: santalodes nitidum
intro: Santalodes nitidum, commonly known as the Australian sandalwood, is a plant species native to Australia and Tasmania, belonging to the family Santalaceae. It is valued for its oil, which is used in traditional medicine and aromatherapy due to its health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Santalodes nitidum oil include its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular ingredient in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alpha-santalol, beta-santalol, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
